comments.note: 63 GUI tests failing across tests/gui/api.test.ts (numerous), api-reset.test.ts, and api-wp-overview.test.ts. Pattern: handlers like handleRenameProject, handleArchiveProject, and others that look up a project by slug are throwing 'Project not found' even when the project was just created. Root cause appears to be that these GUI handlers still construct the storage path using the old flat layout ({ledgerRoot}/{slug}/), while LedgerStore may now write to a namespaced path when repoName is derivable. This is a regression from the namespace-change WPs (WP-001/WP-002) and must be resolved before release.

The listAllProjects() ENOENT stderr log (ledger-store.ts ~line 730) is covered by the 'silently skips namespace subdirectories with no valid .meta.json' test, which confirms the path executes. However there is no test asserting the exact stderr message format. Low priority since the behavior (skip and continue) is verified.

summary: WP-004 code review PASS. The listAllProjects() two-level scan implementation in ledger-store.ts is architecturally sound: correct dot-prefix filtering at both scan depths, graceful ENOENT handling with stderr logging (not crashing), and clear foundAtDepth1 sentinel pattern. The test deliverable (tests/storage/list-all-projects.test.ts) is comprehensive: all 4 ACs are covered, helper functions createFlatProject/createNamespacedProject are clean and reusable, same-slug cross-namespace collision prevention is explicitly tested, and teardown is correct.

One Fix-Forward applied: replaced hardcoded Unix path '/home/user/old-flat-project' in the detectProjectByCwd flat-layout regression test with join(tmpdir(), 'old-flat-project') to comply with the workspace cross-platform policy (AGENTS.md §Cross-Platform Policy). All 10 tests continue to pass.

The pre-existing GUI regression (63 failures in tests/gui/) is outside WP-004 scope but is a confirmed architectural break: all slug-based GUI handlers construct LedgerStore(slug, ledgerRoot) where slug is a bare string — this causes storageDir to resolve to {ledgerRoot}/unknown/{slug}/ instead of {ledgerRoot}/{repoName}/{slug}/. Additionally, direct join(ledgerRoot, slug, ...) path constructions in handleDeleteProject, handleGetPlanDocument, handleGetSynthesisDocument, handleListDialogues, handleGetDialogueFile, handleListChunks, and handleGetChunkFile all use the old flat layout. This must be addressed in a dedicated WP before release.

comments.note: tests/storage/list-all-projects.test.ts: replaced hardcoded Unix path '/home/user/old-flat-project' with join(tmpdir(), 'old-flat-project') and constructed plan_path and cwdPath via join() in the 'detectProjectByCwd() resolves a project stored in the old flat layout' test. This complies with the workspace cross-platform policy (AGENTS.md §Cross-Platform Policy rule 5). The test is logically equivalent — the fake path strings are consistent — but now works correctly on Windows where 'C:\...' paths would be returned by tmpdir(). All 10 tests pass.

BLOCKING PRE-RELEASE: gui/api.ts — every slug-based handler (handleGetProject, handleListWorkPackages, handleGetWorkPackage, handleDeleteProject, handleArchiveProject, handleUnarchiveProject, handleMarkProjectComplete, handleGetPlanDocument, handleGetSynthesisDocument, handleResetProject, handleRenameProject, handleGetProjectHealth, handleGetInsights, handleListDialogues, handleGetDialogueFile, handleListChunks, handleGetChunkFile) calls new LedgerStore(slug, ledgerRoot) with just the slug. deriveRepoName(slug) returns 'unknown' for a bare slug, so storageDir = {ledgerRoot}/unknown/{slug}/ — which does not match the actual namespaced storage location. This causes ledgerDirExists() to return false for every project, producing 'Project not found' for all namespace-stored projects. Root cause of the 63 GUI test failures. Needs a dedicated fix WP.

BLOCKING PRE-RELEASE: gui/api.ts — direct join(ledgerRoot, slug, ...) path constructions at lines 683 (handleDeleteProject), 836 and 863 (plan/synthesis document reads), 1312/1372 (handleListDialogues/handleGetDialogueFile), 1441/1501 (handleListChunks/handleGetChunkFile) all assume the old flat layout {ledgerRoot}/{slug}/. Must be updated to use the resolved storageDir from a LedgerStore instance or via listAllProjects() lookup.

[documentation-forward] listAllProjects() is now the canonical entry point for resolving project storage paths from slugs. The api-surface.md for mcp-server should document that any code that receives only a slug (not a plan_path) must use listAllProjects() to retrieve the ProjectMeta (which contains plan_path) before constructing a LedgerStore instance. This architectural dependency is not currently captured in the manifest.

No other blocking issues found. listAllProjects() in ledger-store.ts is well-implemented: the foundAtDepth1 sentinel is readable, stderr logging in the depth-2 catch block is appropriately non-crashing, and the ENOENT-handling test confirms the skip-and-continue behavior is exercised.
